clips.speaker: Junbelio
clips.title: 刘俊贝：AI资本开支不再是好指标，关注受益者
title_lines: AI资本开支不再是好指标

subtitles.en: If CapEx was formerly the best indicator for the AI trade, what is that indicator now? Look, CapEx is still, it's a very important indicator, but what that is saying is that for the upcoming next five to ten years, or even longer, that it underpins in terms of what's going into that space.
subtitles.zh: 如果资本开支曾是AI交易的最佳指标，现在是什么？资本开支仍然很重要，它预示着未来五到十年甚至更长时间的资金投入方向。

subtitles.en: And so all the companies, what investors looking for, is really all the companies that will benefit from that. It's actually not the company who's spending the CapEx. So investors not sitting there, if you're spending quite a lot of CapEx, then we're going to invest in your shares, whether which language model is going to win out at the ultimate ease, becoming harder, cool for the investors, because everyone is investing a lot of money.
subtitles.zh: 投资者寻找的是受益公司，而不是花钱的公司。不会因为某家公司资本开支大就买入，毕竟大家都在大笔投入，最终哪个语言模型胜出更难判断。

subtitles.en: You remember those companies, hyperscalers, their return will start to deteriorate in the next few years as the depreciation comes through, as some of those CapEx really hitting their P&L. You know, our view is that don't sit in these names, they start going into other businesses. And so valuation is becoming a bigger concern for you? Yeah, absolutely.
subtitles.zh: 超大规模企业的回报未来几年会因折旧和资本开支侵蚀利润而承压。我们的观点是不要持有这些股票，转向其他业务。估值问题越来越重要？是的。

subtitles.en: Yeah, absolutely. Look, I think it's across all the markets, we start seeing valuation becoming issue, simply because we've seen the race cycles now moving up, absolutely towards the up now. We've seen a lot of central banks that are moving the interest rate to the high level, Fed may or may not, but we're certainly expecting at least one this year now. So that one, that means is the valuation is not going to expand, expansion story is done.
subtitles.zh: 所有市场都面临估值问题，因为利率周期在上升，许多央行维持高利率，美联储今年至少降息一次。这意味着估值扩张的故事已经结束。

subtitles.en: It has to be an earning story, you know, for the earning story to take place, it's less likely to be the larger, you know, if it's in the US market, less likely to be the larger hyperscalers because, you know, the earnings perhaps will be under pressure because of the investment that's going into it. Talk to what the resource angle of AI here, and how that features, particularly in markets like Australia, for example, where you have a big commodity sort of presence.
subtitles.zh: 现在必须是盈利故事，但大型超大规模企业盈利可能因投资而承压。聊聊AI的资源角度，比如澳大利亚这样的大宗商品市场。

clips.title: 刘俊贝：AI基建拉动铜等资源，中国估值洼地机会

subtitles.en: Oh, absolutely. Look, I'm always the proponent of the Australian market. So if I'm the resource angle, so for every data center that goes in, you have to have all these commodity precious metals, such as the coppers and the like. Australia is the market that has the biggest, you know, copper producer in the world.
subtitles.zh: 我一直看好澳大利亚市场。从资源角度看，每个数据中心都需要铜等贵金属。澳大利亚拥有全球最大的铜生产商。

subtitles.en: And then the whole long chain of upcoming emerging producer in that space. And remember, copper as a commodity, it's actually very difficult now to get approval from approval to get final, you know, digging out of the ground. It takes 18 years now. That's why you see larger miners around the world are buying existing assets. So it is something that, you know, we see supply continue to become constrained and demand is ever increasing for that space.
subtitles.zh: 还有整个新兴生产商链条。铜矿从审批到开采现在需要18年，所以全球大型矿商在收购现有资产。供应持续受限，需求不断增长。

subtitles.en: So that's a really interesting angle. But aside from commodity, so you know, we've seen the whole area. So there's your energy, your utility, your pipelines, electrification companies, your circuit board. So memory obviously goes into that space. So there's a whole long chain of, you know, sort of businesses that go to that AI built out infrastructure that we've seen that investors now taking more interest in.
subtitles.zh: 这个角度很有趣。除了大宗商品，还有能源、公用事业、管道、电气化公司、电路板、存储等。整个AI基础设施产业链，投资者兴趣正在增加。

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, we talk about the under-owned, unloved sort of markets, right? Yeah, I mean, how much does Australia, you think, deserve to have now in this sort of like rotation, right? And I guess I asked the same question about China as well, just given what we've been seeing in eight shares. Yeah, absolutely. So I think both China and Australia play a really important role. China, especially, especially the Asia, I think it does offer a lot of exposure to their AI models.
subtitles.zh: 我们谈到被低配、被忽视的市场。澳大利亚和内地市场都值得关注。内地市场在亚洲尤其重要，提供了很多AI模型相关敞口。

subtitles.en: So, you know, and the in terms of valuation differential is enormous. I do see that is a, you know, self-contained market where there's a lot of activity you want to be invested in that space. And it's an appreciated compared to the markets like Korea, where we know there's still strong earnings momentum. But I think, you know, the next outperformer will be the likes of China.
subtitles.zh: 估值差异巨大。内地市场自成一体，活动很多，相比韩国等市场仍被低估。我认为下一个表现优异的市场将是内地市场。

clips.speaker: Junbelio
clips.title: 刘俊贝：中国消费信心待修复，AI与科技机会真实

subtitles.en: Australia is a little bit hidden as we talked to. It's not direct AI. We don't have the sexy likes. We are the picks and shovels, they call it, and then the raw material. So we are actually already seeing that thematic emerging in the Australian market, they're much cheaper. These companies are generating good cash flow, good dividend. And then they now have their pipeline suddenly just picked up enormously.
subtitles.zh: 澳大利亚有点隐蔽，不是直接AI，而是卖铲子的角色。这些公司更便宜，现金流和股息好，现在项目管道突然大增。

subtitles.en: And what's also interesting is your Australian market in terms of data-centred investment. There's a couple of years behind what's happening in the US. So we are seeing what has been going so well in the US now playing out in the Australian market. We're a little bit of lag. And as far as China's concern, the earning story seems to be the number one concern. Or the lack of an earning story seems to be the number one concern. Do you share that view? Or are you looking at something else?
subtitles.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心投资比美国落后几年，正在复制美国的故事。至于内地市场，盈利故事似乎是首要担忧，您同意吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah, look, I think with the, in the consumer front, certainly, and corporates. So it's actually, what would they call it, the KShB economy, isn't it? So we've got the one one part, the investment across the AI and others are doing incredibly well. Whereas in the consumer front to the consumption, it's still pretty poor. I think the confidence we are at least seeing the property market, still doing pretty badly, but it is stabilizing.
subtitles.zh: 在消费端和企业端，确实存在K形分化。AI等投资领域表现很好，但消费仍然疲弱。房地产市场虽然仍差，但正在企稳。

subtitles.en: So it's the confidence we need to see real income coming through. And perhaps we'll still a few quarters away. But ultimately, with the consumer not really investing in the housing market and the like, I think it's a massive tailwind into the share market and given where some of those government protected and directed space, the opportunities are the technology, the AI, and I think the opportunities are real there.
subtitles.zh: 信心需要实际收入增长来修复，可能还需几个季度。但消费者不买房，反而成为权益市场的巨大顺风。在政府支持和引导的领域，科技和AI的机会是真实的。
